title: What HTML Is and Is Not
learningObjectives: Explain HTML's role in your own words
Distinguish the roles of HTML, CSS and JavaScript

understand.concept: HTML describes the structure and meaning of web content using elements. It is a markup language, not a general-purpose programming language: HTML alone does not express algorithms, decisions or loops. CSS handles presentation and JavaScript handles programmable behaviour.
understand.whyItMatters: Understanding HTML helps you choose elements that make pages meaningful, maintainable and easier for different users and tools to interpret.
understand.history: HTML grew from the early linked-document web. Verify exact historical milestones against authoritative standards sources before publishing dates.
understand.analogy: HTML is like a plan that organizes the roles of parts in a document.
understand.analogyLimit: HTML is not a visual design tool; CSS controls visual presentation.

explain.narrative: HTML describes the structure and meaning of web content using elements. It is a markup language, not a general-purpose programming language: HTML alone does not express algorithms, decisions or loops. CSS handles presentation and JavaScript handles programmable behaviour.

examples.explanation: The h1 element represents the main heading, while the p element represents a paragraph. HTML gives content structure and meaning; CSS controls presentation, and JavaScript adds programmable behaviour.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser displays the meaningful HTML content.

practise.guidedTask: Identify each element and attribute in the example and explain its role.
